degrees_of_freedom.qualification: The 39 equations need not be algebraically independent; this is a diagnostic count, not a rank proof. The auxiliary separation delta does not add a geometric freedom.

case_matrix.arm: the exact blocker map and 13-support table in input.json

encoded_ledger: Seventeen labeled Euclidean points p0,...,p16, each with two real coordinates.
Sound similarity gauge p0=(0,0), p1=(1,0), licensed by exact point distinctness.
Existential delta>0 and all 136 inequalities squaredDistance(pi,pj)>=delta, encoding exact pairwise point distinctness with a sound finite separation floor.
For each of the 13 listed centers, the four listed support points have equal squared distance from that center: three polynomial equalities per row, 39 total.
Every center/support and support/support distinctness condition is covered by the global pairwise-distinctness constraints.

The input ledger records LP_rho.fresh=4, MP_rho.collisionSource=1, LP.fresh=1, MP.collisionSource=4, K0 omits 4, K10 omits 1, and centers 0 and 10 are distinct. Only the center distinctness is also a metric constraint, through global pairwise distinctness; the remaining facts are provenance records, not extra equations.
omitted_ledger: All blocker-map semantics beyond using each listed image center as the center of its supplied selected support.
All off-support circle inequalities, including metric interpretations of K0 omitting 4 and K10 omitting 1.
The LP/MP and LP_rho/MP_rho incidence meanings beyond their recorded Fin17 labels.
Global minimality and all anonymous deletion rows.
Carrier-wide K4 beyond the 13 selected rows.
Cap membership, cap size/composition, strict convexity, cyclic order, Kalmanson, angular-midpoint, and boundary-order facts.
FreshThird universal ingress, coverage of other finite signatures, any overflow semantics, and any general-cardinality lift.
No-(m,4,4), Moser-set, exact full physical-class support, and every other live residual hypothesis not explicitly listed as encoded.
